messages.content: Use web search to find relevant datasets. Only include landing pages or DOIs. Do not invent links. Do not call time, date, timestamp, or clock tools.

Query: Can you find datasets about Political behaviour and attitudes, SOCIAL STRATIFICATION AND GROUPINGS, Minorities, Equality, inequality and social exclusion, and Cultural and national identity in Germany during the 2010s, matching this research need: German survey data on economic crisis perceptions, authoritarianism, xenophobia, racism, antisemitism, sexism, homophobia, anti-Muslim attitudes, devaluation of minorities, political alienation, nationalism, and social integration, with detailed socioeconomic and migration-background variables.
Respond ONLY as JSON in this exact shape: {"items":[{"title":"...","url_or_doi":"...","justification":"..."}]}. Put any DOI, URL, landing page, or link in url_or_doi.
